CAS — 8016-46-4. Pharmacopoeias. In Eur. (see p.vii). Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Dwarf Pine Oil). An essential oil obtained by steam distillation of the fresh leaves and twigs of Pinus mugo. A suita- ble antoxidant may be added. Relative density 0.857 to 0.868. A clear, colourless or pale yellow liquid. Store in inert, well-filled, airtight containers at a temperature not exceeding 25°. Protect from light. Profile Pumilio pine oil is a volatile oil obtained by distillation from the fresh leaves of Pinus mugo var. pumilio (Pinaceae). It has been inhaled with steam, sometimes with other essential oils, to re- lieve cough and nasal congestion and has been applied externally as a rubefacient. It has also been used as a perfume. P. mugo is a source of pine needle oil (see Pine Oil, p.2368).
